data.body: **[P1] Rebind operation-owned error data at the execution boundary.** For an uncaught `DurableOperationException`, `buildErrorObject` returns its error unchanged. If the operation used an override offloader, chained callers using the handler’s global offloader cannot load the terminal error and receive `PayloadOffloadException`. Resolve it using the exception’s stored source policy, then re-offload under the root `EXCEPTION` context. Add coverage with differing operation/global offloaders and a chained caller.
